description: This file contains ARM64 assembly code for cryptographic operations, specifically Montgomery multiplication and squaring functions used in BoringSSL's implementation of elliptic curve cryptography. It includes functions for multi-precision multiplication, squaring, reduction, and conditional subtraction for modular arithmetic, with references to external cryptographic modules and assembly macros.

methods.name: _bn_mul_mont
methods.description: Assembly implementation of Montgomery multiplication for big integers.

methods.name: __bn_sqr8x_mont
methods.description: Assembly implementation of optimized squaring for 8x8 multi-precision integers.

methods.name: __bn_mul4x_mont
methods.description: Assembly implementation of 4x4 multi-precision Montgomery multiplication.
